other_text: On December 16th, 2011, eight people on their way to Las Vegas stopped in the ghost town of Garlock, California. This footage documents what happened.
description: Poster shows a destroyed building with rubble and a dark void, accompanied by text describing a mysterious incident in Garlock, California.
